newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil dips off high to close unchanged.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil dips off high to close unchanged.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed unchanged on Tuesday having retraced early losses in afternoon trade.
But the June contract slipped off the session high of $179 a tonne shortly before the close to finish at $177.75 a tonne.
A rally on U.S. gasoline, the seasonal market leader, and some short-covering on NYMEX crude pulled oil futures in London off early lows.
Dealers said that the upside move was triggered by news that Turkish Kurdish rebels had attacked a small oil installation in southeast Turkey.
"It was reports of Kurdish attacks that gave us the push," said one.
July Brent was trading six cents up at $20.22 a barrel at 1703 GMT, having rallied to a high of $20.36 in mid-afternoon trading.
On the physical market a wet Brent cargo traded at July Brent -10 cents late on Tuesday, 10 cents up on a deal on Monday.
